title: AI for Data Analysis: Excel, Google Sheets & Power BI
subtitle: Use ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot and Gemini to write formulas, clean data, build MIS reports and Power BI dashboards — and verify every number.
description:
This course is for MIS executives, accountants, operations and sales analysts, MBA students and anyone in India whose work runs on spreadsheets. If you spend evenings fighting VLOOKUPs, rebuilding the same monthly report, or wondering whether you can trust an AI-generated total, this course is built for you.

You will learn to use AI assistants as a spreadsheet co-pilot: describing your sheet so you get correct XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, INDEX-MATCH, IF, text and date formulas the first time; understanding and repairing inherited formulas; cleaning messy data with duplicates, name variants and text dates; and summarising it with pivot tables. You will then upload data to ChatGPT or Claude for analysis, use Copilot in Excel and Gemini in Sheets, and move into Power BI with DAX measures explained in plain English.

Every example uses realistic Indian data — a Jaipur retailer's GST-inclusive sales, a Bengaluru startup's leads sheet, a Nagpur distributor's branch MIS — and every lesson ends with a hands-on exercise. A strong thread runs throughout: data privacy (never uploading PAN or Aadhaar, masking customer data) and verification, so the numbers you present are numbers you can defend.

By the end you will have four portfolio projects: a cleaned and analysed 1,000-row sales dataset, a refreshable pivot-based monthly MIS report, a one-page dashboard in Power BI or Google Sheets, and a five-insight executive summary.
audience: MIS executives and analysts who build monthly reports in Excel or Google Sheets
Accountants and CA-firm staff working with sales registers and expense data
Operations and sales analysts who want to become the team's go-to data person
MBA and commerce students preparing for analyst and business roles
Anyone who uses spreadsheets daily and wants to work faster with AI
outcomes: Get correct XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, INDEX-MATCH, IF, text and date formulas from AI, and understand them
Explain, audit and fix complex inherited formulas using AI and Excel's auditing tools
Clean messy data: duplicates, inconsistent names, text dates, currency text and outliers

faqs.q: Do I need to know advanced Excel or coding before joining?
faqs.a: No. You should be comfortable entering data and writing a simple SUM formula. The course builds up lookups, SUMIFS, pivots and Power BI step by step, and the Python lesson is optional and written for people who have never coded.

faqs.q: Do I need paid versions of ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or Power BI?
faqs.a: Free versions of chat assistants are enough for formula help and most exercises. File-upload analysis, Copilot in Excel and Gemini in Sheets depend on your plan and your organisation's settings, so we teach the skills in a way you can apply with whatever you have. Power BI Desktop is free on Windows; Mac users can do the dashboard project in Google Sheets.

faqs.q: Is it safe to put my company's data into AI tools?
faqs.a: Only if your organisation allows it. A full lesson covers checking your company's policy, never uploading PAN, Aadhaar or bank details, and masking customer data — and the projects use realistic practice datasets so you never need real customer data to learn.

faqs.q: Will this course get me a data analyst job?
faqs.a: No course can promise a job. What you will have is practical skills employers ask for in MIS and analyst roles, plus four portfolio projects you can describe in interviews and show in a sanitised form.
